query:
SELECT ova.ventureId, v.name, v.status
FROM org_venture_access ova
LEFT JOIN ventures v ON v.id = ova.ventureId
WHERE ova.organizationId = (SELECT id FROM organizations WHERE slug = 'royalton')
AND v.id IS NULL
